theta_hat_source.authority: plan v2.1 line 6 and section 3.1 line 139 (theta_hat = DeltaC_corrected(D))
disclosures: Computed on D by scripts/38 with 5 x 500 event-stratified optimism replicates; each outer replicate of the interval uses B_in = 100 (same functional, different inner Monte Carlo precision; plan section 1).

Its Monte Carlo SE (about 0.00019) excludes the cross-validation randomness on D that selected lambda; the apparent DeltaC on D is one CV realisation (default_rng(20261102) per model, scripts/38 lines 90-92).

Historical seeding convention: CV draws come from one advancing generator after each resample (scripts/38 lines 117-129); the apparent-CV generator on D starts from the same state as the first resample of seed 20261102 (not evaluated; bounded in the alignment audit).
